title: Door Latch Mortise Jig for Router, Red Aluminium Door Installation Kit with Router and Self-Centring Drill Bits, PH2/SL6 Driver and Hex Key, for 1 x 2-1/4 in Latch Plates
bullets: GUIDED LATCH RECESSES: Use this door latch mortise jig to guide routing for latch faceplate recesses in timber doors. A practical addition to door installation tools for new fittings, replacement latches and renovation projects. Designed for latch plates, not strike plates or full lock-body mortises.

CHECK YOUR FIT: Designed for 1 x 2-1/4 in (25.4 x 57.15 mm) latch plates on wooden doors that are 1-3/8 in or 1-3/4 in thick (34.9 or 44.5 mm). Confirm your hardware dimensions before use; square-corner plates may require chisel trimming after routing.

ANODISED ALUMINIUM BODY: The red aluminium alloy body provides a rigid routing template for repeat setup. At 8 x 8 x 5 cm, the jig is compact enough to keep with your door latch installation kit between woodworking and maintenance jobs.

DEPTH REFERENCE MARKS: Built-in 1 mm, 2 mm and 3 mm reference marks help with routing-depth setup. Match the cut to your latch plate and check on a suitable test piece before working on the door. The marks are setup references, not automatic depth stops.

JIG AND FOUR ACCESSORIES: Includes one mortise jig, a 1/2 in router bit, a 9/64 in self-centring drill bit, a PH2/SL6 double-ended screwdriver bit and a hex key. Check shank and tool compatibility before use. Router, drill, door and latch hardware are not included.
